## Page.nextCursor property

Present exactly when more items remain after this page: send the same inputs again with this value as `cursor` to read the next page. Absent means the listing is complete. Opaque: its content is not part of the contract.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly nextCursor?: string;
```
